      Throughout the relative interior of a presilting cone the semistable modules are exactly those at the integral class of the presilting complex.

      source
      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.realStableAt_iff_stable_of_mem_cone_interior {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) (X : FGModuleCat R) {v : RealProjectiveSpace R} (hv : v ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ ↑P.gVectorCone) :
      RealStableAt k v X ↔ (eulerWeight k P).IsStable X

      Stability, including the isomorphism classes of all stable modules, is constant throughout the relative interior of the cone.

      source
      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.wall_face_iff_unique_stable_presilting_facet {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] :
      BrickWallFaces k ↔ ∀ (X : FGModuleCat R), IsBrick X → ∃ (P : TwoTerm R), P.IsPresilting ∧ Module.finrank ℝ ↥(Submodule.span ℝ ↑P.gVectorCone) + 1 = Module.finrank ℝ (RealProjectiveSpace R) ∧ (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable X ∧ ∀ (Y : FGModuleCat R), (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable Y → Nonempty (X ≅ Y)

      The real wall-face endpoint can be checked at one integral presilting weight for each brick, with the same codimension requirement.
